paragraphs: His son Rabbi Avin: Jerusalem Talmud Bikkurim, beginning of chapter 2.[^1]

notes.text: The stored Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Bikkurim 2:1 scalar explicitly names Rabbi Avin son of Rabbi Tanchum bar Trifon (טריפון). This supports Rabbi before Tanchum and Avin and the son-of direction. Hyman's heading has Tarfon (טרפון) with an abbreviated father title, retained as R'; the edition gives no title before Trifon. Neither spelling nor rank is silently harmonized.
